    count(*) as n_records

from prod.dbt_dev_marts.fact_encounters
where encounter_key is not null
group by encounter_key
having count(*) > 1

with all_values as (

    select
        abnormal_flag as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from prod.dbt_dev_marts.fact_lab_results
    group by abnormal_flag

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'High','Low','Normal'
)
